content._README: Here's some compiled data about the character. Should be fairly human-readable. The <character> section is what WG reads, this section is solely for you! Should give you an abundance of compiled stats and info about the character. If you have any questions, feel free to ask on our Discord!

item.name: Hunter's Anthem
item.description:
This [+2](link_item_7951) [striking](link_item_7862) [longbow](link_item_7088) is carefully handcrafted from a length of flexible green-tinted wood, etched in a variety of runic symbols, and strung with a dawnsilver bowstring. When you shoot the bow in rapid succession, the echoing chords generated by the bowstring form a haunting dirge that evokes the inevitable end of all things. If you have the [Hunt Prey](link_feat_19728) class feature, the weapon gains the [thundering](link_item_7890) rune on [Strikes](link_action_19856) against your prey.

**Activate—Song of the Bow** <abbr cost="TWO-ACTIONS" class="action-symbol">2</abbr> ([concentrate](link_trait_1432)); **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You shoot an arrow thrumming with the song of the bow. Make a [Strike](link_action_19856) with the bow that deals damage as normal. As long as the [Strike](link_action_19856) isn't a critical failure, the arrow explodes in a 20-foot emanation around your target, dealing 5d10 sonic damage to creatures in the area, including the target, with a DC 28 basic Fortitude save. Any creature that critically fails is deafened for 1 minute. If any creature in the area is undetected or unnoticed by you, you learn its location, making it hidden to you instead.

base_item_content.name: Shortbow
base_item_content.description: This smaller bow is made of a single piece of wood and favored by [skirmishers](link_feat_20547) and cavalry.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Dirty Trick
generalAndSkillFeats.requirements: You have a hand free and are within melee reach of an opponent.
generalAndSkillFeats.description:
You hook a foe’s bootlaces together, pull their hat over their eyes, loosen their belt, or otherwise confound their mobility through an underhanded tactic. Attempt a Thievery check against the target’s Reflex DC.

**Critical Success** The target is clumsy 1 until they use an [Interact](link_action_19733) action to end the impediment

**Success** As critical success, but the condition ends automatically after 1 round.

**Critical Failure** You fall prone as your attempt backfires.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Experienced Smuggler
generalAndSkillFeats.description:
You often smuggle things past the authorities. When the GM rolls your Stealth check to see if a passive observer notices a small item you've concealed, the GM uses the number rolled or 10—whichever is higher—as the result of your die roll, adding it to your Stealth modifier to determine your Stealth check result. If you're a master in Stealth, the GM uses the number rolled or 15, and if you're legendary in Stealth, you automatically succeed at hiding a small concealed item from passive observers. This provides no benefits when a creature attempts a Perception check while actively searching you for hidden items.

**PFS Note** This feat allows you to Earn Income with Underworld Lore with tasks of your level -1 (instead of the normal level -2).

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Experienced Tracker
generalAndSkillFeats.description: Tracking is second nature to you, and when necessary you can follow a trail without pause. You can [Track](link_action_19861) while moving at full Speed by taking a –5 penalty to your Survival check. If you're a master in Survival, you don't take the –5 penalty. If you're legendary in Survival, you no longer need to roll a new Survival check every hour when tracking, though you still need to roll whenever there are significant changes in the trail.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Pickpocket
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You can [Steal](link_action_19852) or [Palm an Object](link_action_19743) that's closely guarded, such as in a pocket, without taking the –5 penalty. You can't steal objects that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor or actively wielded objects). If you're a master in [Thievery](link_action_19852), you can attempt to [Steal](link_action_19852) from a creature in combat or otherwise on guard. When doing so, [Stealing](link_action_19852) requires 2 actions instead of 1, and you take a –5 penalty.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Read Lips
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You can read lips of others nearby who you can clearly see. The language read must be one that you know. When you're at your leisure, you can do this automatically. In encounter mode or when attempting a more difficult feat of lipreading, you're fascinated and off-guard during each round in which you focus on lip movements, and you must succeed at a Society check (DC determined by the GM) to successfully read someone's lips.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Terrain Stalker
generalAndSkillFeats.description:
Select one type of difficult terrain from the following list: rubble, snow, or underbrush. While undetected by all non-allies in that type of terrain, you can [Sneak](link_action_19850) without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement.

During [exploration](link_trait_1457), this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while [Avoiding their Notice](link_action_21146), as long as they aren't actively [Searching](link_action_21204) or on guard.
generalAndSkillFeats.special: You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different type of terrain.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Quick Disguise
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You can set up a disguise in one-tenth the usual time (generally 1 minute). If you're a master in Deception, you can create a full disguise and [Impersonate](link_action_19731) as a 3-action activity. If you're legendary, it takes a single action.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Shadow Mark
generalAndSkillFeats.description:
You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

When you attempt a Stealth check to [Avoid Notice](link_action_21146) while following a specific target, the target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC. If you have master proficiency in Stealth, the penalty is -3 or -4 if you're legendary.

If you start an encounter with the target while shadowing them, the target takes this penalty to their initiative roll and to their Perception DC to determine if they notice you, as normal for [Sneak](link_action_19850).

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Graft Technician
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You can create and implant grafts. When you select this feat, you gain the formulas for four common grafts of 3rd level or lower. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to implant grafts. If you're a master in Medicine, this bonus increases to +2.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: We're on the List
prerequisites: Alter Ego Dedication or Archaeologist Dedication
generalAndSkillFeats.trigger: An ally you can see and hear is about to attempt a Deception check to Impersonate someone or Lie.
generalAndSkillFeats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.
generalAndSkillFeats.description: Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same. Attempt a Society check to [Aid](link_action_19604) your ally. If you succeed, you recall a few specific details about local culture and personalities to help support your ally's deception. In addition to the benefits of your [Aid](link_action_19604), the triggering ally rolls their Deception check twice and takes the better result. This is a [fortune](link_trait_1460) effect.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Change of Face
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look-luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques. When you [Impersonate](link_action_19731), you don't need a [disguise kit](link_item_6877); instead, simple illusions or temporary transmutations ripple over your body like mirror shards, providing the supplies that the kit ordinarily would. When you Impersonate in this way, your Impersonate activity gains the [occult](link_trait_1514) trait.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Biographical Eye (legacy)
generalAndSkillFeats.description:
In even a brief conversation or social interaction, you pick up on subtle social and visual cues to learn a great deal about a person's origin and history. You might notice bits of green under the person's fingernails and determine they're an herbalist, a pin indicating their membership in a secret society, or something similar. You pick up on only details that have to do with their societal role, so you might learn the city district where a [vampire](link_trait_2470) lives, but wouldn't learn any of their weaknesses, nor necessarily even that they are a vampire.

Spend 1 minute in the presence of someone you haven't met before, or haven't met since you first gained Biographical Eye, then attempt a Society 30 check. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check if you engaged the person in conversation during this time. If the person is deliberately trying to conceal their nature or present a false identity, you learn about their false biography rather than their true one unless the result of your Society check exceeds their Will DC.

**Critical Success** You learn the creature's profession, their specialty within that profession, and a major accomplishment or controversy from their career. You also learn the nation and settlement where they live, as well as the district in a city large enough to have districts. In addition, you learn the nation or settlement where they spent their formative years.

**Success** You learn the creature's profession and specialty within that profession. You learn the nation or settlement where they normally live.

**Failure** You learn the creature's profession and the region of the world they hail from, but no more.

**Critical Failure** You learn a piece of erroneous information about the creature.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Foil Senses
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You are adept at foiling creatures' special senses and cautious enough to safeguard against them at all times. Whenever you use the [Avoid Notice](link_action_21146), [Hide](link_action_19726), or [Sneak](link_action_19850) actions, you are always considered to be taking precautions against special senses.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Kip Up
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

data.text: **Quick Unlock** You can Pick a Lock using 1 action instead of 2.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Quick Unlock
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You can [Pick a Lock](link_action_19747) using 1 action instead of 2.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Swift Sneak
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You can move your full Speed when you [Sneak](link_action_19850). You can use Swift Sneak while [Burrowing](link_action_19609), [Climbing](link_action_19612), [Flying](link_action_19721), or [Swimming](link_action_19859) instead of [Striding](link_action_19855) if you have the corresponding movement type.

data.text: **Tumbling Theft** If you critically succeed at your check to Tumble Through an enemy's space, you can attempt to [Steal](link_action_19852) something from the enemy as a reaction. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Thievery check to Steal as your tumbling make it difficult for your enemy to keep track of your movement. You can [Steal](link_action_19852) any immediately accessible item of light or negligible Bulk on the enemy's person, such as a potion or coin purse hanging from a belt, but not anything inside a container or anything the enemy is holding. The GM has final say on what you can [Steal](link_action_19852).
when attempting to Steal during a critically successful Tumble Through

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Tumbling Theft
generalAndSkillFeats.description: You reach for an opponent's item as you move past a foe. If you critically succeed at your check to [Tumble Through](link_action_19867) an enemy's space, you can attempt to [Steal](link_action_19852) something from the enemy as a reaction. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Thievery check to Steal as your tumbling make it difficult for your enemy to keep track of your movement. You can [Steal](link_action_19852) any immediately accessible item of light or negligible Bulk on the enemy's person, such as a potion or coin purse hanging from a belt, but not anything inside a container or anything the enemy is holding. The GM has final say on what you can [Steal](link_action_19852).

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Snap Out of It! (Pathfinder Agent)
generalAndSkillFeats.description:
Pathfinders are trained to help each other be safe and successful, and you know how to jolt your allies back to their senses. Attempt a Medicine check on an adjacent ally who is fascinated, frightened, stunned, or stupefied and choose one of those conditions. The DC is the DC for the effect that caused the condition.

**Critical Success** Reduce the value of the chosen condition by 2. If you chose fascinated, that condition ends.

**Success** Reduce the value of the chosen condition by 1. If you chose fascinated, that condition ends.

**Failure** The target is unaffected.

**Critical Failure** You increase the value of the chosen condition by 1. If you chose fascinated, increase the duration by 1 round instead.

data.text: **Incredible Scout** You grant your allies a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls instead of a +1 circumstance bonus.

generalAndSkillFeats.name: Incredible Scout
generalAndSkillFeats.description: When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight. When using the [Scout](link_action_21196) [exploration](link_trait_1457) activity, you grant your allies a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls instead of a +1 circumstance bonus.

classFeats.name: Debilitating Strike
classFeats.trigger: Your Strike hits an off-guard creature and deals damage.
classFeats.description:
You apply one of the following debilitations, which lasts until the end of your next turn.

*   **Debilitation** The target takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.
    
*   **Debilitation** The target becomes enfeebled 1.

classFeats.name: Nimble Dodge
classFeats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.
classFeats.description: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

classFeats.name: Trap Finder
classFeats.description:
You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the presence of traps. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps, to AC against attacks made by traps, and to saves against traps. Even if you aren’t [Searching](link_action_21204), you get a check to find traps that normally require you to be [Searching](link_action_21204). You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap.

You can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of master in Thievery. If you have master proficiency in Thievery, you can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of legendary instead, and your circumstance bonuses against traps increase to +2.

classFeats.name: Quick Draw
classFeats.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion. You [Interact](link_action_19733) to draw a weapon, then [Strike](link_action_19856) with that weapon.

classFeats.name: Dread Striker
classFeats.description: You capitalize on your enemies’ fear to slip past their defenses. Any creature that has the frightened condition is also off-guard against your attacks.

classFeats.name: Skirmish Strike
classFeats.description: Your feet and weapon move in tandem. Either [Step](link_action_19853) and then [Strike](link_action_19856), or [Strike](link_action_19856) and then [Step](link_action_19853).

classFeats.name: Blind-Fight
classFeats.description:
Your heightened senses allow you to instinctively detect unseen opponents. You don’t need to succeed at a flat check to target concealed creatures. You’re not off-guard to creatures that are hidden from you (unless you’re off-guard to them for reasons other than the hidden condition), and you need only a successful DC 5 flat check to target a hidden creature.  
While you’re adjacent to an undetected creature of your level or lower, it is instead only hidden from you.

data.text: When you roll a failure on a Sneak action, you get a success instead.

classFeats.name: Sneak Adept
classFeats.description: It’s almost impossible to spot you. When you roll a failure on a [Sneak](link_action_19850) action, you get a success instead. You can still critically fail.

classFeats.name: Bloody Debilitation
classFeats.description:
Your attacks slice arteries and veins. Add the following debilitation to the list you can choose from when you use [Debilitating Strike](link_feat_19621).

*   **Debilitation** The target takes 3d6 persistent bleed damage.

ancestryFeats.name: Cooperative Nature
ancestryFeats.description: The short human life span lends perspective and has taught you from a young age to set aside differences and work with others to achieve greatness. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to [Aid](link_action_19604).

ancestryFeats.name: Natural Ambition
ancestryFeats.description: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class. You must meet the prerequisites, but you can select the feat later in the character creation process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.

data.text: **Cooperative Soul** If you are at least an expert in the skill you are Aiding, when you roll a failure or critical failure to Aid a skill check, you get a success instead.

ancestryFeats.name: Cooperative Soul
ancestryFeats.description: You have developed a soul-deep bond with your comrades and maintain an even greater degree of cooperation with them. If you are at least an expert in the skill you are [Aiding](link_action_19604), when you roll a failure or critical failure to Aid a skill check, you get a success instead.

ancestryFeats.name: Bounce Back
ancestryFeats.description: You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience. Don’t increase the value of your wounded condition due to losing the dying condition.

otherFeats.name: Assume a Role
otherFeats.requirements: You've spent at least 1 hour studying a creature whose role you intend to copy and have done so within the last 3 days. This could include meeting and learning from someone in that role, tailing and spying on someone, using magic to observe them at work, or some other method, as long as you have a visual source of information
otherFeats.description: You quickly and accurately learn how to do mundane jobs or at least copy the movements enough to appear as if you do. A chosen role can take many forms—from cook, cleaner, or librarian to cult member, priest, or duke—but it's always a role and never a specific individual.

otherFeats.name: Thief Racket
otherFeats.description:
Nothing beats the thrill of taking something that belongs to someone else. You might be a pickpocket working the streets, a cat burglar sneaking through windows, or even a consultant, testing your clients’ vaults for openings.

When a fight breaks out, you prefer swift, lightweight weapons, and you strike where it hurts. When you make a melee [Strike](link_action_19856) with a [finesse](link_trait_1570) weapon or [finesse](link_trait_1570) unarmed attack, you can add your Dexterity modifier to damage rolls instead of your Strength modifier.

You are trained in Thievery. Dexterity is your key attribute.

otherFeats.name: Alter Ego Dedication
otherFeats.description: You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility. You become an expert in Deception. You gain the [Assume a Role](link_feat_25429) activity.
otherFeats.special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the alter ego archetype.

otherFeats.name: Sound Mirror
otherFeats.description: You twist not just the visual, but the auditory as well, allowing you to pass without a sound and create minor noises as distractions-perfect for misdirection and infiltration. You can cast [silence](link_spell_4836) on yourself as a 2nd-rank innate occult spell and [ventriloquism](link_spell_4931) as a 1st-rank innate occult spell, both once per day. You also can cast [figment](link_spell_4620) as an innate occult cantrip. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your key spellcasting attribute for alter ego archetype spells is Charisma.

data.text: when you are within dim light or darkness

otherFeats.name: Shadowdancer Dedication
otherFeats.description:
You dedicate yourself to the shadows. Your coloring becomes gray and gloomy, your senses adjust to the darkness, and you can [sneak](link_action_19850) through darkness with ease.

You gain [greater darkvision](link_sense_20770). You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks when you are within dim light or darkness.
otherFeats.special: You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the Shadowdancer archetype.

otherFeats.name: Shadow Magic
otherFeats.description:
You gain the ability to fuse and play with shadows by using focus spells specific to shadowdancers.

You learn a shadowdancer focus spell of your choice: [dance of darkness](link_spell_5211) or [shadow jump](link_spell_5265). If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can [Refocus](link_action_19754) by meditating within an area of dim light or darkness.

Shadowdancer focus spells are occult spells. You become trained in occult spell attack rolls and spell DCs, and your spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma.

otherFeats.name: Additional Shadow Magic (Shadowdancer)
otherFeats.description: Choose an additional shadowdancer focus spell you haven't already selected from [Shadow Magic](link_feat_22321). Increase the number of Focus Points in your pool by 1.

classFeatures.name: Rogue's Racket
classFeatures.description: You’ve begun to develop your techniques and approach to a job, while building your reputation in rogues’ circles. Choose a rogue’s racket from the list below.

classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
classFeatures.description:
When your enemy can’t properly defend itself, you take advantage to deal extra damage. If you [Strike](link_action_19856) a creature that has the off-guard condition with an [agile](link_trait_1569) or [finesse](link_trait_1570) melee weapon, an [agile](link_trait_1569) or [finesse](link_trait_1570) unarmed attack, a ranged weapon attack, or a ranged unarmed attack, you deal an extra 1d6 precision damage. For a ranged attack with a [thrown](link_trait_1575) melee weapon, that weapon must also be [agile](link_trait_1569) or [finesse](link_trait_1570).

As your rogue level increases, so does the number of damage dice for your sneak attack. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

classFeatures.name: Surprise Attack
classFeatures.description: You spring into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if you roll Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures that haven’t acted are off-guard to you.

classFeatures.name: Deny Advantage
classFeatures.description: As someone who takes advantage of openings, you are careful not to leave such gaps yourself. You aren’t off-guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, or creatures of your level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

classFeatures.name: Weapon Tricks
classFeatures.description: You gain expert proficiency in simple weapons, martial weapons, and unarmed attacks. When you critically succeed at an attack roll against an off-guard creature while using an [agile](link_trait_1569) or [finesse](link_trait_1570) weapon or an [agile](link_trait_1569) or [finesse](link_trait_1570) unarmed attack, you apply the critical specialization effect for that weapon or unarmed attack.

data.text: When you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

classFeatures.name: Evasive Reflexes
classFeatures.description: You’ve learned to move quickly to avoid explosions, dragons’ breath, and worse. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master. When you roll a success on a Reflex save, you get a critical success instead.

classFeatures.name: Perception Mastery
classFeatures.description: You have highly developed acuity and attention to detail. Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master.

classFeatures.name: Weapon Specialization
classFeatures.description: You've learned how to inflict greater injuries with the weapons you know best. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master, and 4 if you're legendary.

classFeatures.name: Debilitating Strike
classFeatures.description: When taking advantage of an opening, you both hinder and harm your foe. You gain the [Debilitating Strike](link_feat_19621) free action.

data.text: When you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

classFeatures.name: Rogue Resilience
classFeatures.description: Your physique is incredibly hardy. Your proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to expert. When you roll a success on a Fortitude save, you get a critical success instead.

classFeatures.name: Rogue Expertise
classFeatures.description: Your techniques are now harder to resist. Your proficiency rank for your rogue class DC increases to expert.

data.text: When you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
When you roll a failure against a damaging effect, you take half damage.

classFeatures.name: Greater Rogue Reflexes
classFeatures.description: You elude danger to a degree that few can match. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to legendary. When you roll a critical failure on a Reflex save, you get a failure instead. When you roll a failure on a Reflex save against a damaging effect, you take half damage.

classFeatures.name: Light Armor Expertise
classFeatures.description: You've learned how to dodge while wearing light or no armor. Your proficiency ranks for light armor and unarmored defense increase to expert.

classFeatures.name: Master Tricks
classFeatures.description: You’ve mastered a rogue’s fighting moves. Your proficiency ranks increase to master for all simple weapons, martial weapons, and unarmed attacks.

classFeatures.name: Perception Legend
classFeatures.description: You notice things almost impossible for an ordinary person to detect. Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to legendary.

heritages.name: Versatile Human
heritages.description: Humanity's versatility and ambition have fueled its ascendance to be the most common ancestry in most nations throughout the world. Select a [general](link_trait_1437) feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.
